values.note: Regular site $45 a day with full hookup for 1-3 people, $1 per extra guest; weekly $270 (seventh night free). Monthly $750 plus electric (metered or $100 flat); seasonal (May 1 - Oct 1) $2,185, $2,585 near the office. Visitors $3 a day, $5 overnight. The small and large cabins ($75, $85) carry a 2-night minimum; the RV sites do not. The site's banner advertises the 2026 season.

note: Wooded campground on Bear Swamp Rd in Peru (Clinton Co), formerly Iroquois Campground and RV Park; loops in pines around a 2-acre pond, pool, cabins. Google 4.2 over 105 reviews. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site (browser; Cloudflare): $45/day full hookup for 1-3 people, weekly $270, cabin minimums, phone (518) 643-9057. Added full hookups with 50-amp upgraded sites, pull-throughs, laundry, camp store, reservable on the park's site, monthly/seasonal rates in the fee note. Note trimmed of the RV Life rating line. Not stated: campground season (only the May 1 - Oct 1 seasonal-rental period), site count, showers by name, site lengths.
flags: Long-stay tests pass: a $45 daily rate is posted with no minimum for RV sites, booked online or by phone; but the banner reads 'Only 9 Seasonal Spaces Left! Reserve Your Site for 2026 Season!' and monthly ($750 + electric) and seasonal ($2,185-2,585, May 1 - Oct 1) rates are offered, so much of the park may be seasonal.
Price gate: $45/night base (1-3 people), under US$50. The family has not stayed here.

Ownership: the site footer lists the park under 'INVESTORADE COMMUNITY HOLDINGS' with seven other RV parks, while the home page says it is owned and operated by Dave and Blake DeWitt; private either way.
